# Cursor asset notices
## Fluent model cursor
The adopted model body in cursor-assets.hpp derives from Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons, `assets/Cursor/SVG/ic_fluent_cursor_16_filled.svg`, pinned at commit `9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774`.
[Upstream SVG](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/blob/9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774/assets/Cursor/SVG/ic_fluent_cursor_16_filled.svg) (SHA-256 `b107bfe61b65166d2cbd5f8316168d88a993fbf1ad3f4c5dbc53f5ea9e2fc164`). [Upstream license](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/blob/9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774/LICENSE).
Modifications: approved preview variant `fluent16-w90-white` reconstructs the body with 90% width. The approved 2026-11-16 derivative increases circular corner radius to 1.2 while preserving the straight-edge directions and leg angle. `src/assets/cursor-geometry.cjs` converts circular fillets to tangent-continuous cubic Beziers with sweeps at most 45 degrees for both native and logo assets. Native rendering supplies the preview's white outline and uniform scale separately.

## LAIO palette
All 12 families and six tones (72 RGB colors) are copied exactly from the registered `appDefaults` and `eventVariantDefaults` embedded in the approved preview. No runtime user overrides are included. Registered defaults source:
`C:/Users/felre/Desktop/Life-All-In-One/apps/laio_app/lib/services/color_palette_service.dart`
Source SHA-256: `dbe1fec89c84b49f8014f6b4b35a8a0df87bd60b913f9acbbb422326ceb7cecf`. Design reference: `C:/Users/felre/Desktop/Life-All-In-One/docs/design/app/color-system.md`.
## User cursor redraw and preview provenance
The user paths are the approved preview's seven-fillet geometric redraw of the approximate Windows native arrow style. `C:/Windows/Cursors/aero_arrow.cur` was used as a visual reference (SHA-256 `06678bbf954f0bece61062633dc63a52a34a6f3c27ac7108f28c0f0d26bb22a7`). No Windows cursor binary or embedded reference image is copied into these native assets; this redraw does not claim an exact pixel match to the Windows cursor.
Frozen geometry and palette source: `work/EZ-01-window-use-multipointer-review/cursor-motion-preview.html`. Preview SHA-256: `cc60b5b2effdf8719ac4e92e99b17994e73617919370c720cd208593fb87732c`.
Radius 1.2; {"front":{"x":118,"y":146},"back":{"x":170,"y":103},"height":139,"rearScale":1,"opacity":0.5}
